Single-Cell RNA-seq Analysis in R — Full Pipeline

Mouse skin aging (GSE336400) · Sessions 1–5

Chang, Nai-Wen

2026-08-13

How to use this file · 使用方式

  1. Open in RStudio. Edit only the EDIT HERE chunk in section 1. 只改第 1 節的 EDIT HERE 區塊。
  2. Click Knit (or run chunks top-to-bottom). 按 Knit，或由上往下逐塊執行。
  3. You get one self-contained HTML report with every plot. 你會得到一份含所有圖表的 HTML 報告。

Each install.packages / BiocManager::install line only needs to run once — after installing, set eval=FALSE or comment them out. 安裝指令只要跑一次。

1 Setup — packages & paths · 套件與路徑

1.1 Install once · 安裝（只做一次）

# CRAN 套件 CRAN packages
install.packages(c("Seurat", "tidyverse", "harmony", "patchwork",
                   "BiocManager", "enrichR", "ggrepel"))

# Bioconductor 套件 Bioconductor packages
BiocManager::install(c("scDblFinder", "SingleCellExperiment",
                       "SingleR", "celldex", "DESeq2"))

1.2 Load every session · 每次都要載入

library(Seurat)                 # 單細胞主套件 core toolkit
library(tidyverse)              # 資料整理 + ggplot2 data wrangling + plots
library(harmony)                # 批次整合 batch integration
library(patchwork)              # 圖表拼接 combine plots
library(scDblFinder)            # 去雙細胞 doublet detection
library(SingleCellExperiment)   # SCE 物件 SCE class
library(SingleR)                # 自動註解 automated annotation
library(celldex)                # 參考資料庫 reference datasets
library(enrichR)                # 功能富集 (ORA) functional enrichment
set.seed(123)                   # 讓有隨機性的步驟可重現 reproducibility

1.3 EDIT HERE · 只改這一塊

# ---- 你的六個樣本資料夾（含 barcodes/features/matrix 三件組）----
# ---- your six sample folders (each holds the 10x triplet) ----
sample_dirs <- c(
  "GSE336400_RAW/8wk_ctrl",  "GSE336400_RAW/8wk_Apo",
  "GSE336400_RAW/26wk_ctrl", "GSE336400_RAW/26wk_Apo",
  "GSE336400_RAW/52wk_ctrl", "GSE336400_RAW/52wk_Apo")

# ---- 每個路徑對應一個短名稱（順序要一致）----
# ---- one short name per path, in the SAME order ----
sample_names <- c("8wk_ctrl", "8wk_Apo",
                  "26wk_ctrl", "26wk_Apo",
                  "52wk_ctrl", "52wk_Apo")

stopifnot(length(sample_dirs) == length(sample_names))  # 兩者要一樣長 must match

# 老鼠粒線體基因用小寫 "^mt-"（人類是 "^MT-"）
# mouse mito genes are lowercase "^mt-" (human = "^MT-")
mt_pattern <- "^mt-"

# 輸出資料夾 output folder for cleaned .rds
dir.create("rds", showWarnings = FALSE)

2 Session 2 — Clean each sample · 清理每個樣本

We wrap Steps 1–5 (load → QC → doublets → normalize → scale) into one function, then loop over all six samples, saving one .rds each. 把五步驟包成一個函式，跑完六個樣本，各存一個 .rds。

process_sample <- function(path, name, mt_pattern = "^mt-") {
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(                       # 1) 讀入三件組 load triplet
    counts = Read10X(path),
    project = name, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

  seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)  # 2) 算粒線體% mito%

  seu <- subset(seu, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &  # 3) QC 過濾 filter cells
                             nFeature_RNA < 6000 &
                             percent.mt   < 15)

  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu)              # 4) 去雙細胞 doublet removal
  sce <- scDblFinder(sce)
  seu$scDblFinder.class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
  seu <- subset(seu, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

  seu <- NormalizeData(seu) |>                     # 5) 正規化 + 挑 HVG + 縮放
         FindVariableFeatures() |>
         ScaleData()
  seu
}
# 一次跑完六個樣本，各存一個 .rds · process all six, save one .rds each
for (i in seq_along(sample_dirs)) {
  message("Processing ", sample_names[i])
  seu <- process_sample(sample_dirs[i], sample_names[i], mt_pattern)
  saveRDS(seu, file.path("rds", paste0(sample_names[i], "_clean.rds")))
}

QC snapshot of one sample · 單一樣本 QC 圖 這裡示範最後一個樣本的 QC 分布，讓報告裡看得到過濾後的品質。

VlnPlot(seu, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)

3 Session 3 — Integrate, cluster, annotate · 整合、分群、註解

3.1 Load + merge · 讀回並合併

files <- list.files("rds", pattern = "_clean.rds$", full.names = TRUE)  # 列出六個 .rds
obj_list <- lapply(files, readRDS)                                      # 逐個讀入
names(obj_list) <- sub("_clean.rds$", "", basename(files))              # 用檔名當名稱

sc_integrated <- merge(obj_list[[1]], obj_list[-1],                     # 合併成一個物件
                       add.cell.ids = names(obj_list))
sc_integrated$sample <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", colnames(sc_integrated))     # 樣本 8wk_ctrl ...
sc_integrated$age    <- sub("_.*", "", sc_integrated$sample)            # 年齡 8wk/26wk/52wk
sc_integrated$geno   <- sub(".*_", "", sc_integrated$sample)            # 基因型 Apo/ctrl
sc_integrated
## An object of class Seurat 
## 18836 features across 32850 samples within 1 assay 
## Active assay: RNA (18836 features, 2000 variable features)
##  18 layers present: counts.26wk_Apo, counts.26wk_ctrl, counts.52wk_Apo, counts.52wk_ctrl, counts.8wk_Apo, counts.8wk_ctrl, data.26wk_Apo, scale.data.26wk_Apo, data.26wk_ctrl, scale.data.26wk_ctrl, data.52wk_Apo, scale.data.52wk_Apo, data.52wk_ctrl, scale.data.52wk_ctrl, data.8wk_Apo, scale.data.8wk_Apo, data.8wk_ctrl, scale.data.8wk_ctrl

3.2 Harmony integration · 整合去批次

sc_integrated <- NormalizeData(sc_integrated) |>   # 標準前處理 standard preprocessing
                 FindVariableFeatures() |>
                 ScaleData() |>
                 RunPCA()
sc_integrated <- RunHarmony(sc_integrated, group.by.vars = "sample")   # 按樣本去批次
# 整合前 vs 整合後：用樣本上色看批次是否混合
sc_integrated <- RunUMAP(sc_integrated, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
DimPlot(sc_integrated, group.by = "sample")        # 依樣本上色 by sample (should be mixed)

3.3 Cluster · 分群

sc_integrated <- FindNeighbors(sc_integrated, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)  # 鄰居圖
sc_integrated <- FindClusters(sc_integrated, resolution = 0.5)                     # 切分群
DimPlot(sc_integrated, label = TRUE) + NoLegend()  # 依分群上色 by cluster

3.4 Markers · 找每群 marker

sc_integrated <- JoinLayers(sc_integrated)                          # v5 先合併 layers
markers <- FindAllMarkers(sc_integrated, only.pos = TRUE,           # 每群 vs 其餘 one-vs-rest
                          min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.csv(markers, "cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)        # 匯出，可丟 AI 分析 export
head(markers, 10)
# 用點圖確認每群身分 confirm cluster identity with a DotPlot
DotPlot(sc_integrated,
        features = c("Col1a1","Krt14","Lyz2","Cd3d","Pecam1",
                     "Rgs5","Cd207","Top2a","Acta1")) + RotatedAxis()

3.5 Manual annotation · 手動命名

先看上面的 DotPlot 再改這裡！ 群數與對應要照你自己的資料調整。 Check the DotPlot first! Match the mapping to YOUR own clusters.

# ⚠ 範例對照（依 18 群、resolution 0.5）— 同名的群會自動合併
# example mapping — clusters sharing a name are merged automatically
new_ids <- c("0"="Keratinocyte", "1"="Keratinocyte", "2"="Keratinocyte",
             "3"="Fibroblast",   "4"="Keratinocyte", "5"="Keratinocyte",
             "6"="Fibroblast",   "7"="Fibroblast",   "8"="Macrophage",
             "9"="Keratinocyte", "10"="T cell",      "11"="Endothelial",
             "12"="Dendritic",   "13"="Cycling",     "14"="Pericyte",
             "15"="Keratinocyte","16"="Keratinocyte","17"="Muscle")

# 只保留資料裡真的有的 cluster（避免群數不符報錯）
# keep only ids that actually exist (avoids a length mismatch error)
present <- levels(sc_integrated$seurat_clusters)
new_ids <- new_ids[present]

Idents(sc_integrated) <- "seurat_clusters"
sc_integrated <- RenameIdents(sc_integrated, new_ids)   # 編號 → 名字
sc_integrated$celltype <- Idents(sc_integrated)         # 存回 meta.data
# 固定配色，之後每張圖都用同一組 named colour vector, reused everywhere
ct_cols <- c(Fibroblast="#C4683F", Keratinocyte="#4E7A4E", Macrophage="#3E6E8E",
             `T cell`="#B0843A", Endothelial="#8A5A9E", Pericyte="#C25E7A",
             Dendritic="#5B8C88", Cycling="#7A7A55", Muscle="#8A6E4B",
             Melanocyte="#9E7B3A", `Mast cell`="#B36A4A")
DimPlot(sc_integrated, cols = ct_cols, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()

3.6 SingleR · 自動註解並比對

ref  <- MouseRNAseqData()                              # 小鼠參考資料庫 mouse reference
pred <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(sc_integrated, layer = "data"),
                ref = ref, labels = ref$label.main,
                clusters = sc_integrated$seurat_clusters)   # 逐群標記 label per cluster
sc_integrated$SingleR <- pred$labels[match(sc_integrated$seurat_clusters,
                                           rownames(pred))]
table(manual = sc_integrated$celltype, SingleR = sc_integrated$SingleR)  # 手動 vs 自動

3.7 Functional enrichment (ORA, Enrichr) · 功能富集

# 需要連網 needs internet. 設 eval=TRUE 再跑 · set eval=TRUE to run
setEnrichrSite("Enrichr")
dbs <- c("GO_Biological_Process_2023", "KEGG_2019_Mouse", "MSigDB_Hallmark_2020")

# 例：某群的 marker 基因做富集 · enrich one cluster's markers
genes <- markers |> dplyr::filter(cluster == "8", avg_log2FC > 0.5) |> dplyr::pull(gene)
res <- enrichr(genes, dbs)
head(res[["MSigDB_Hallmark_2020"]][, c("Term","Overlap","Adjusted.P.value")], 8)

3.8 Save the annotated atlas · 存檔

saveRDS(sc_integrated, "rds/skin_integrated_annotated.rds")   # 下游用 for downstream

4 Session 4 — Aging biology · 老化生物學

How to define young vs aged · 年輕 vs 老化怎麼定義 Each week has a ctrl and an Apo. For a pure age effect, compare same genotype (e.g. 52wk_ctrl vs 8wk_ctrl). Here we group agegrp = young(8wk) / aged(52wk) within a chosen genotype. 每週都有 ctrl 與 Apo；要看純老化效應，比較同一基因型。

sc <- sc_integrated                                    # 短名 shorter handle
sc$agegrp <- dplyr::recode(sc$age,                     # 8wk→young, 52wk→aged, 26wk→mid
                           "8wk" = "young", "52wk" = "aged", "26wk" = "mid")

4.1 Cell-type proportion shift · 細胞比例變化

prop <- sc@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(sample, agegrp, celltype) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sample) |>
  dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

ggplot(prop, aes(sample, frac, fill = celltype)) +     # 每樣本堆疊組成 stacked composition
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ct_cols) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

4.2 Differential expression: aged vs young · 差異表現

Compare aged vs young within one cell type. True pseudobulk (DESeq2) needs ≥3 biological replicates per group; this dataset has only 2 samples per age (ctrl + Apo), so here we use the single-cell Wilcoxon test. When you have ≥3 replicates per group, switch to the pseudobulk block shown after. 在單一細胞型內比較。真正的 pseudobulk（DESeq2）每組需 ≥3 個生物重複；本資料每個年齡只有 2 個樣本，故此處用單細胞 Wilcoxon 檢定；有 ≥3 重複時再換成後面的 pseudobulk 寫法。

fib_cells <- subset(sc, celltype == "Fibroblast" & agegrp %in% c("young","aged"))  # 只取纖維母細胞
Idents(fib_cells) <- "agegrp"
de <- FindMarkers(fib_cells, ident.1 = "aged", ident.2 = "young")   # 單細胞 Wilcoxon；+值=老化上調
head(de, 10)
# 有 ≥3 重複時的正確做法（此資料重複數不足，設 eval=FALSE）
# proper pseudobulk when you have >=3 replicates per group (disabled here)
pb <- AggregateExpression(sc, group.by = c("celltype","sample","agegrp"),
                          assays = "RNA", return.seurat = TRUE)
fib <- subset(pb, celltype == "Fibroblast" & agegrp %in% c("young","aged"))
Idents(fib) <- "agegrp"
de <- FindMarkers(fib, ident.1 = "aged", ident.2 = "young", test.use = "DESeq2")
# 火山圖 volcano plot
de$gene <- rownames(de)
de$sig  <- ifelse(de$p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(de$avg_log2FC) > 1, "sig", "ns")
library(ggrepel)
ggplot(de, aes(avg_log2FC, -log10(p_val_adj), colour = sig)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(ns = "grey70", sig = "#C4683F")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(de, sig == "sig") |> head(10),
    aes(label = gene), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

5 Session 5 — Visualization cookbook · 視覺化

All the go-to figures from the annotated object. 從註解好的物件畫出常用圖。

5.1 DimPlot & FeaturePlot

DimPlot(sc, cols = ct_cols, label = TRUE) + NoLegend()

FeaturePlot(sc, features = c("Col1a1","Lyz2","Cd3d","Pecam1"),
            order = TRUE, min.cutoff = "q10", max.cutoff = "q90")

5.2 VlnPlot, DotPlot, RidgePlot

VlnPlot(sc, features = "Krt14", group.by = "celltype",
        cols = ct_cols, pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()

DotPlot(sc, features = c("Col1a1","Krt14","Lyz2","Cd3d","Pecam1")) + RotatedAxis()

RidgePlot(sc, features = "Krt14")

5.3 Multi-panel with patchwork · 拼圖

p1 <- DimPlot(sc, cols = ct_cols, label = TRUE) + NoLegend()
p2 <- FeaturePlot(sc, "Krt14")
p3 <- VlnPlot(sc, "Krt14", cols = ct_cols, pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
(p1 | p2) / p3 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

5.4 Export a figure · 存出投稿圖

# 向量檔給論文、PNG 給投影片 · vector for paper, PNG for slides
ggsave("umap_celltype.pdf", p1, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave("umap_celltype.png", p1, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
